newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPAIN LOSE ALKORTA AND HIERRO FOR MALTA CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPAIN LOSE ALKORTA AND HIERRO FOR MALTA CLASH.

text.p: Spain will be without Real Madrid defenders Rafael Alkorta and Fernando Hierro for Wednesday's World Cup qualifier in Malta.
Alkorta is suspended after picking up a yellow card in Saturday's 2-0 win over Yugoslavia while Hierro has not yet recovered from a knee injury. Both players have stayed in the Spanish capital.

The absences could mean the reappearance of Real Sociedad defender Agustin Aranzabal and the debut of Deportivo Coruna midfielder Armando Alvarez, who was unexpectedly called up to the squad after Jose Luis Caminero pulled out through injury.
